register.labelZh: GET ON 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GET ON Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: get on 可以描述人們相處得好不好;get on at somebody 則可以描述不停責備或催促某人。；登上巴士、火車、旅遊巴、渡輪或飛機時,經常會使用 get on。；get on the phone 表示致電;get onto somebody 則表示聯絡某人或機構,而不必額外說明聯絡方式。；get on something 可以表示開始處理工作;get onto something 可以表示對話開始談到某個話題。
register.summaryEn: Get on can describe how well people live, work or study together. Get on at somebody can describe repeated criticism or complaints. Get on is commonly used when somebody boards a bus, train, coach, ferry or plane. Get on the phone shows that a telephone call is made. Get onto somebody means contacting that person or organisation without adding an unnecessary method. Get on something can show that work has begun. Get onto something can show that a conversation has reached a particular subject.
